Backend: taxonomy.service + listing.controller + listing.routes — GET /listing/tree, GET /listing/nodes/:id/facets (public), POST /brands/me/products/batch (brand). Locked-dropdown + required-facet validation; whole-batch reject on any invalid item. Multi-image -> facets._images. VALIDATED end-to-end on local inflx_dev (migration applies, seed loads, tree/facets/validate work, insert + GIN facet filter string+array proven). pnpm qa not runnable in sandbox -> qa_all_green=null. ship2_1.what: Engine completion per founder: (1) Unisex added as a real segment + Men-first segment order (Men/Women/Unisex/Kids) — re-seed; now 4 segments / 35 categories / 195 leaves / 95 facets. (2) Migration 096: brands.store_code + brands.product_seq (auto-SKU) + listing_brands directory (39 popular fashion brands seeded + custom capture). (3) batchCreate now auto-assigns per-product SKU (STORECODE-#### from business name, atomic seq block) + derives variant sub-SKUs (CODE-####-CLR-SIZE), accepts Brand (→facets.brand + directory upsert), and per-colour variant pics + per-size stock (→variants_json {sku,cover_images,colors:[{color,images,sizes:[{size,stock,price,sku}]}]}). (4) New GET /listing/brands?vertical=&q= (public brand search). VALIDATED local: store_code QATE→SKU QATE-0001→sub-SKU QATE-0001-BLU-32, brand capture+search, rolled back. Additive — existing wizard calls keep working (SKU now auto-filled as a bonus). Ship 2.2 (brand-web wizard UI) DONE: Brand field (datalist via getBrands) + SKU override + per-colour variant card (photos + per-size stock → variants[]) + section-progress counts; listingApi.getBrands added. Parse-checked; founder on-web gate. NAV WIRED (2026-06-09): products page now redirects drill-down verticals (fashion/furniture) from the legacy flat ListingWizard to /dashboard/products/listing — so 'Listings' opens the NEW drill-down wizard. Backend batchCreate fully completed (auto store_code + CODE-#### SKU + per-colour variants→variants_json w/ sub-SKUs + custom-brand capture); getBrands live; migration 096 + Unisex/Men-first re-seed applied to PROD (verified). FURNITURE LIVE (2026-06-09, Ship 2.3): seeded onto the same engine — 9 families / 73 item-types / 87 facets / 20 brands (vertical='furniture', 2-level Family→Item-type) via scripts/seed-furniture-taxonomy.js + CSVs in features/listing-furniture-vertical/. Wizard generalized: vertical auto-detected from brand schema (furniture*→furniture else fashion); size special-case gated by leaf.size_system (furniture variant facets Seater/Doors/Seats render from allowed_values); per-colour stock card uses the non-color variant facet generically; added dimension input. Verified live: GET /listing/tree?vertical=furniture returns 9 families. STORE-SETUP DONE (2026-06-09, Ship 2.4): fashion.json brand_config — gender_focus → multi_select [Men,Women,Unisex,Kids] required; removed online_delivery_cities + shipping_fee_flat; added ships_international (show_if offers_online_delivery); default_return_policy_days → optional override (admin global default already exists in payment_config.return_window_days, admin-editable); dropped product_authoring step (registration steps = brand_basics/brand_photos/preview/done; products live ONLY in the drill-down wizard). Reachability: product wizard has a '⚙ Store setup' link → /dashboard/products?setup=1; the products-page redirect honours ?setup=1 (stays on store-setup instead of bouncing to the wizard). DEFERRED: same delivery/return treatment for furniture store-setup (furniture.json has no brand_config.fields yet — uses generic). FOUNDER-REPORTED FIXES (2026-06-10, Ship 2.5): (1) facet mis-scoping — Fabric/Pattern/Care were scope=ALL and leaked onto Belts/Sunglasses/Jewellery/Watches; moved to the 11 apparel category scopes (125 facet rows); + getNodeFacets now DEDUPES by facet_key with most-specific-scope-wins (leaf>category>ALL) fixing e.g. double Occasion on jewellery. Fashion re-seeded FACETS_ONLY=1 (new seed flag — tree untouched because 1 live product references nodes). Verified live: Belt/Earrings/Sunglasses/Watch clean; Jeans/Saree correctly keep fabric. (2) furniture tree was flat 2-level (Seating=18 items in one list) — restructured to fashion-style grouped drill-down: Family → Group → Item-type (9 families / 17 groups / 73 leaves; small families Pooja&Decor + Accessories stay 2-level, variable depth is native). Verified live on /listing/tree?vertical=furniture. (3) furniture brand was STILL landing on the legacy flat products page (founder screenshot, 2026-06-10): furniture.json was phase=5/status=coming_soon → isCategoryActive=false → listing_engine_active=false → legacy products CRUD rendered and the drill-down redirect (gated on that flag) never fired. Fixed: furniture.json → phase 1/active; products-page redirect now runs on mount for any DRILLDOWN_VERTICALS category, independent of the legacy listing-engine flag (?setup=1 escape preserved). (4) Blank store-setup/Add-Product for furniture (founder, 2026-06-10): furniture.json had ZERO brand_config.fields + ZERO listing_steps (stub) → '?setup=1' rendered 'STEP 01/00' blank. Fixed: furniture.json now mirrors fashion's store-setup — 6 fields (description, online-delivery + ships_international, hours, furniture amenities incl. Installation/Carpenter/EMI/Made-to-Order, optional return-window override) + 4 steps (brand_basics/brand_photos/preview/done) + real actions (Visit&Pay / Shop Online / Request Quote — fixes the restaurant-ish Book Table preview); fashion brand_basics.field_keys cleaned of removed delivery fields. FLOW locked per founder: FIRST visit (listing_data empty) → one-time store-setup wizard; AFTER setup → Listings goes STRAIGHT to the product wizard; '⚙ Store setup' (?setup=1) edits later. Implemented via listing-config listing_data check in the products-page redirect. (5) Same blank-Add-Product trap existed for fashion's setup page: ListingTemplateLayout's Add/Bulk tabs + fleet buttons switched to the in-page 'add' view, which is EMPTY for drill-down templates (no product step since registration is profile-only). Fixed generically: hasProductStep detection (any step not writes_to:brand and not preview/done); when absent, Add Product / Bulk Upload / fleet-add route to /dashboard/products/listing. Restaurant/salon/car_rental unaffected (they have authoring steps).
